taste:
Lavazza Filter Coffee is smooth and medium-bodied, with gentle roasted nut notes and a subtle, naturally sweet undertone. Its character is well rounded rather than harshly bitter, making it an approachable choice if you prefer an easy-drinking coffee. The nutty notes describe the flavour profile, not a confirmed ingredient list. There is enough body to make the cup feel satisfying without the flavour being described as intense.

It arrives steaming hot in a ceramic mug, freshly brewed and ready to accompany breakfast or a quiet afternoon pause. The warming character is central to its appeal. Free refills all day make it worth considering when you want more than a single cup.
